_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving.
You shall take the first fruits and set them before God.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving.
He is the bread of life; whoever comes will never hunger.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Bring the first basket of the harvest, the good of the ground, and remember where it came from.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving!
We were wanderers, and God brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving!
So we set our gifts down and we rejoice — we and the stranger among us together.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving!
For Christ is the bread of life; come to him and you will never be hungry again.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Bring the first of the harvest; remember the Giver.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving.
We were wanderers; God brought us home.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving.
Christ is the bread; come and never hunger.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving. Amen.
